title: Oven Roasted Egyptian Porcini Tagine
description: A spicy and velvety Egyptian dish featuring porcini, perfect for a post-workout meal, with a smoky heat that will satisfy your cravings. This paleo-friendly recipe is made with wholesome ingredients and is easy to prepare.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, garlic, ginger, cumin, coriander, cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chopped onion to the bowl and toss to coat with the spice mixture.
Spread the onion mixture in a single layer on a large baking sheet.
Roast the onion mixture in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the dried porcini mushrooms to the baking sheet and toss to combine with the onion mixture.
Continue to roast for an additional 10 minutes, or until the mushrooms are tender.
Remove the baking sheet from the oven and let it cool slightly.
Serve the porcini tagine hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro if desired.
